paragraphs: When taking over, the active, reactive power and vibration of each unit are reviewed first, and abnormalities are noted; during the day shift, the monitor screen is guarded, and the opening of the guide vane is adjusted when the load command comes; in conjunction with maintenance, preventive tests are performed, bolts are tightened and carbon brushes are tightened; before the shift is over, tripping and alarms are written in the log.
